what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guinea in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17586 Guinean asylum seekers in the United States, 31.1% of all asylum seekers from Guinea.
Refugees from Guinea, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Belgium and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Guinea in later years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 360 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
